# C17 — Vikalpa–Saṃkalpa

## #0

Vikalpa–saṃkalpa names the paired movement through which a bounded cognitive field differentiates alternatives and gathers selected determinations into an intention, course or workable world. The power is constructive. It makes a course possible while retaining the difference between forming that course and having it already fixed.

[A07 — Vikalpa / Saṃkalpa / Script](../A07-Vikalpa-Samkalpa-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) **grounds** the argument. C17 owns the active movement; [C12 — Script](C12-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) **tests** its arrest when the formed course forgets how it came to be and repeats as necessity.

## #1

The circumstance precedes its explicit apportionment. Frank's protected encounter with [[symbolon/episteme/sources/analytic-philosophy/kripke/kripke-1981-naming-and-necessity/kripke-1981-naming-and-necessity.md|Kripke — Naming and Necessity]] **sources** the authorial pressure: name and instance have their rigidity within a circumstantial whole that can be available before it is explicitly counted or propositionally divided. This is the setting in which this-rather-than-that becomes meaningful.

The constructive pair does not invent an arbitrary field from nothing. [C16 — Inner Instrument](C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md) **defines** the determining, appropriating and coordinating functions through which alternatives become locally available. [C18 — Apoha](C18-Apoha.md) **defines** the constitutive exclusion that a formed distinction carries.

## #2

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md|Taylor — Core Theorems]], XI, **grounds** the operational cartography: vikalpa articulates qualified alternatives; saṃkalpa gathers selected differences into a possible act. The shared formative root is worked as arrangement, not irreversible severance. The text's Sanskrit morphology remains an internal lexical lead until independently warranted.

A selection both narrows and enables. Its gathering must retain enough of the alternative field for the result to remain intelligible and revisable. The `earlier developed carrier` **sources** the two failures: differentiated content claims independent subsistence; gathered content presents its arrangement as the only possible world. The constructive operation survives both failures as their condition of correction.

## #3

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration.md|Dyczkowski — The Doctrine of Vibration]], pp.71–72, **sources** concrete reflective capacities: retain an affection, recall its trace, select from retained material and compose a new imaginative state. Remembering and imagining differ even though both use retained conditions. An intention gives the selected formation direction toward an act; the finished act does not retroactively erase its other possibilities.

Nirvikalpa and śuddha-vikalpa mark distinct limits in the earlier carrier. The first concerns awareness without constructed alternatives. The second bears the image of thought as medicine for thought: a formation directed toward the release of an entrenched formation, including its own eventual obsolescence. This image restores the essay's positive use of revisable thought; detailed Pratyabhijñā exegesis remains a named source task.

## #4

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/maccracken/maccracken-2017-recognizing-recognition/maccracken-2017-recognizing-recognition.md|MacCracken — Recognizing Recognition]] **qualifies** the historical field. Its pp.1–2 locate a dispute over whether relations are merely epistemic or contrived, and why Śaiva realists contest that position. It does not define saṃkalpa or make Buddhist construction and Śaiva Śakti one doctrine.

The essay's constructive account retains its own claim while exposing this difference. Articulation, conceptual construction, resolve and imagination are related through their operations; their translation as one generic “mental processing” would remove what the comparison must explain. [C13 — Prakāśa / Vimarśa](C13-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) **grounds** the reflexive field in the Śaiva reading.

## #5→0

[C44 — Prompt Thrownness](C44-Prompt-Thrownness.md) **compares** an inherited machine action-space: a prompt conditions which alternatives can be proposed, selected and carried forward. The comparison becomes investigable where changing a condition changes the available course. It supplies no identity between inference and lived cognition.

[[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD|Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Account]] **grounds** the register3 return: a selected account gathers a region without exhausting it. [C47 — Deferential Intelligence](C47-Deferential-Intelligence.md) **tests** whether encounter can reopen the gathering. C17 **returns-to** A07 with the formation active again: what was chosen remains a possible act whose conditions can be reconsidered.

**Depth Restoration:** circumstantial whole, forming-apart/gathering, paired failures, retained-trace/recollection/imagination differences, medicine-for-thought image, historical disagreement and technical condition-change are restored.

**Unresolved Delta:** exact Sanskrit morphology and classical nirvikalpa/śuddha-vikalpa treatment need independent passage recovery. MacCracken does not define saṃkalpa. Dyczkowski's source-matched local transcript is paraphrased, with edition collation pending. The authorial operation is not a claim of common doctrinal identity or completed technical experimentation.
